print("\nN objects after:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]

after_seg = current_frame.segmentation

after_hashes = {n['hash']: n for n in after_seg['nodes']}

print("\nChanged hashes:")
for h in set(list(before_hashes.keys()) + list(after_hashes.keys())):
    if h not in before_hashes:
        n = after_hashes[h]
        b = n['boundary']
        center = (b[0][0], b[0][1])

    elif h not in after_hashes:
        n = before_hashes[h]
        print(f"  REMOVED: hash={h}, color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
    else:
        bn = before_hashes[h]
        an = after_hashes[h]
        if bn['pixels'] != an['pixels'] or bn['children'] != an['children'] or bn['color'] != an['color']:
